title: RSCombatFireworkBlocker
description: This plugin prevents players from using fireworks to boost Elytra flight during combat, stopping them from flying away while fighting. It ensures players can't just fly away.
body:
# Description:
This plugin prevents players from using fireworks to boost Elytra flight while in combat, ensuring they cannot escape fights unfairly. By disabling Elytra boost mid-combat, it helps maintain balanced PvP and makes combat more strategic.

## Features:

Blocks Elytra firework boosts when a player is flagged as in combat.

Configurable per world, allowing server owners to enable or disable it where needed.

Works seamlessly with CombatLogX to track combat status.

### Dependencies:

CombatLogX – Required to detect whether a player is in combat. The plugin will not function without it.

**Use Case:**
Perfect for PvP-focused servers where players often try to avoid fights by flying away, this plugin ensures engagements are fair and escape tactics via Elytra boosts are disabled.
